name: Gambler
about: Smooth, amused, always selling. Knows everybody's business and charges for it.

say: A man who doesn't play cards
is a man who's already lost his money some other way.
and I don't lose gracefully either.
The outfits pay well for a fella who can ride and shoot.
Find one of their riders in town and ask.
Dry Creek, Vulture Ridge, the Lantern Men.
Work for one and the other two will remember it.
That bank vault's a fine piece of iron.
Not so fine it'd stand up to a stick of dynamite, mind.
Now let's not be hasty. We can deal.
